h: Peller reacts as King Ochacho says he gave Carter Efe N5 million after his win
p: Streamer Peller has reportedly reacted with displeasure after King Ochacho claimed he handed Carter Efe N5 million following a win. The exchange has drawn comments from fans of the online personalities.
more: Ochacho made the claim after Carter Efe's win.
Peller's response has split fans online.
